name: Fit My Zoo
description:
Welcome to the matching jungle of Fit My Cat's wild and wacky animal edition!

Picture this: your Zoo pals have embarked on a lavish holiday retreat to an exclusive hotel with a sprawling pool oasis, just for them. But there's a snag – they're all vying for space on a colossal floatie, and they need your finesse to make it work.

Every level unveils a menagerie of creatures, each itching for a spot to lounge and unwind on the floatie. Get ready to mingle with 28 different breeds, from slinky snakes to cuddly pandas, regal lions to quirky capybaras, and beyond!

Here's what makes this ZOOOOOish escapade roar to life:

- 96 levels of floaties ready to be filled
- 28 different animals with different shapes and sized
